shortcut: Secrets rotation cascade failure across services
detail: When a shared secret (database password, API key, TLS certificate) is rotated in one service but not updated in all dependent services, a cascade of authentication failures occurs across the entire system. The database connection fails, API authentication is rejected, and internal service-to-service communication breaks. This cross-domain failure affects backend services, CI pipeline credentials, docker registry access, and kubernetes secret mounts simultaneously. The error is catastrophic because it affects all environments and requires coordinated secret updates. Prerequisite: understanding secret management and rotation strategies. Requires automated secret rotation with synchronized updates. To mitigate: use short-lived tokens instead of long-lived secrets, implement automated rotation with vault or AWS Secrets Manager. Fix: deploy centralized secret management, use sidecar pattern for secret injection, test rotation in staging before production.
